column3: secretive person, one who is not open
rote learner, one who memorizes by cramming
large old copper coin, dhyak coin
with a gush, pouring all at once
with a snap of the teeth, with a nip
conjuring, magic trick, sleight of hand
fourteenth day of the lunar fortnight
world of the moon, lunar realm
skinny, scrawny, thin as a bird's claw
facial blemish, dark patch on the face
eye discharge, sleep in the eyes
to rinse the mouth and hands after eating
vehicle roof, roof of a bus
with a crash, with a clatter
to lash, to rope down a load
to hobble, to tether by the legs
to winnow, to sift with a tray
with a snip, with a quick cut
patron of a priest, client of a priest
long live Nepal, victory to Nepal
in a fit of anger, with a jerk
caste-based commensality, caste rules on food
species and subspecies, classes and subclasses
service land, land granted in lieu of salary
philosophy of life, outlook on life
kitchen cleaning, cleaning up after meals
ritual impurity (after a birth or death)
cultivation and payment of land tax
to get entangled, to tangle together
in a sudden fit of anger
to make resound, to liven up with music
with a flash, with a flicker
to become ragged, to wear out
to grow thin, to waste away
with a snap (of a rope breaking)
drying off (of a cow or buffalo)
to end, to be finished, to be settled
with a crack, with a snap
kinsman of the same caste or clan
with a thud, with a bang
to have punished, to cause to be fined
body and mind, heart and soul
